hypotheses.reasoning: At 11:36:02 template-svc reloaded MAILER_API_KEY from the secrets store (#115). It moved to version 18, and the previous version 17 was revoked. Within 50s every email provider call fails with 401 Unauthorized (invalid API key) (#125, #134, #137, #146). Before the reload, all renders succeeded. Those 401s show up in template-svc as 502s. notification-svc then fails TemplateClient.render (#131, #135, #149, #157), and api-gateway returns 502 on POST /v1/notify (#127 onward). Ruled out: the connection reset at 11:30 (#44) succeeded on retry. The slow audit_log query (#60) is unrelated, and redis, notif-db and notif-worker logged no errors.
The email provider itself could be rejecting valid keys. But the 401s start right after the key rotation, and the only earlier provider error (#44) was a brief reset that succeeded on retry.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll MAILER_API_KEY back to a valid credential (restore version 17 if the provider will accept it again), or make sure version 18 is registered and active with the mailer provider. Then reload the template-svc secrets. Add a check that tests a new key against the provider before the old one is revoked.
